long_biography.plain_text:
After graduating from Washington Business College in New York, Attila Türker worked in several American industries before joining the management of Mutlu Akü in 1960. The battery producer had been founded years earlier by Cemil Türker and was identified as a second-generation family company. Türker eventually became chairman as it expanded production, distribution and exports from its Istanbul base.

In 2013, Türker and other family shareholders agreed to sell Mutlu Holding and related battery interests to Metair. Non-productive property assets were separated before the transaction and became the foundation of Türker Proje, a listed real-estate investment and development company. Türker has chaired the company since its formation and continues to lead Türker Yatırım Holding and family tourism businesses, remaining both an operating executive and a substantial indirect shareholder.
